*Modelling 2026* class schedule.
Links appear below as material is released -- slides and exercises are generally posted before class, solutions after.
The reading in the "Preparation" column should be completed before class.
The textbook is [here](https://au-bce-ee.github.io/modeling-py-book/).

```{python}
#| echo: false
import csv
import re
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path
from IPython.display import HTML, display

root = Path(".")

ZOOM_URL = "https://aarhusuniversity.zoom.us/j/61345517558"

BOOK_URL = "https://au-bce-ee.github.io/modeling-py-book/"
BOOK_CHAPTERS = {
    1: "01_intro",
    2: "02_components_formulation",
    3: "03_solving",
    4: "04_heat_transfer",
    5: "05_mass_transfer",
    6: "06_reactions_microbiology",
    7: "07_spatial_models",
    8: "08_verification_validation",
    9: "09_parameter_estimation",
    10: "10_time_variable_inputs",
}

def link_prep(prep):
    m = re.fullmatch(r"Chapter (\d+)", prep)
    if not m or int(m.group(1)) not in BOOK_CHAPTERS:
        return prep
    slug = BOOK_CHAPTERS[int(m.group(1))]
    return f'<a href="{BOOK_URL}{slug}.html">{prep}</a>'

def material_links(class_num, subdir):
    folder = next(root.glob(f"classes/{int(class_num):02d}-*/{subdir}"), None)
    if folder is None:
        return ""
    links = []
    for item in sorted(folder.iterdir()):
        if item.suffix in (".qmd", ".md"):
            href = item.with_suffix(".html")
            links.append(f'<a href="{href.as_posix()}">{item.stem}</a>')
        elif item.suffix in (".pptx", ".pdf"):
            links.append(f'<a href="{item.as_posix()}">{item.stem}</a>')
    return ", ".join(links)

rows_html = []
with open("schedule.csv", newline="", encoding="utf-8-sig") as f:
    for row in csv.DictReader(f):
        class_num = row["Class"].strip()
        topic = row["Topic"].strip()
        location = row["Location"].strip()
        prep = row["Prep"].strip()
        day = row["Day"].strip()
        teacher = row["Teacher"].strip()
        location = row["Location"].strip()

        try:
            date = datetime.strptime(row["Date"].strip(), "%d-%m-%Y").strftime("%d %b %Y")
        except ValueError:
            date = row["Date"].strip()

        if class_num.isdigit():
            slides = material_links(class_num, "slides")
            exercises = material_links(class_num, "exercises")
            solutions = material_links(class_num, "solutions")
        else:
            slides = exercises = solutions = ""

        if location == "Online":
            location = f'<a href="{ZOOM_URL}">Online</a>'

        prep = link_prep(prep)

        rows_html.append(
            "<tr>"
            f"<td>{class_num}</td><td>{date}</td><td>{location}</td><td>{topic}</td><td>{teacher}</td><td>{prep}</td>"
            f"<td>{slides}</td><td>{exercises}</td><td>{solutions}</td>"
            "</tr>"
        )

table_html = (
    "<table class='table table-striped'><thead><tr>"
    "<th>Class</th><th>Date</th><th>Location</th><th>Topic</th><th>Teacher</th><th>Preparation</th>"
    "<th>Slides</th><th>Exercises</th><th>Solutions</th>"
    "</tr></thead><tbody>" + "".join(rows_html) + "</tbody></table>"
)
display(HTML(table_html))
```
